developer.title: Full Stack Developer
developer.tagline: Full stack software engineer experienced in web products, application architecture, and scalable platforms.
developer.bio: Full Stack Developer focused on well-built interfaces, scalable backends, and digital experiences that combine clarity, performance, and real value.
developer.availability: Open to opportunities, collaborations, and conversations about technology.
summary: From an early age, curiosity about how websites, systems, and games work brought me closer to programming. Starting from game modifications and the desire to understand what happened behind the interface, a genuine relationship with technology was born.
Today I act as a full stack developer building web applications and complete solutions, from frontend to backend, through architecture, integrations, deployment, observability, and software quality.
I enjoy environments where product, engineering, and user experience walk together. My goal is to create useful, solid, and pleasant-to-use software.

hookroute.name: HookRoute
hookroute.description: A platform for asynchronous webhook ingestion, auditing, and delivery, with equivalent Java/Spring Boot and NestJS implementations, an isolated worker, and an operational Next.js console.
highlights: Asynchronous ingestion with transactional outbox, queues, and a dedicated worker
Exponential retries, idempotency, DLQ, replay, and circuit breaker
HMAC security, observability, and a mutation-tested test suite

space_portfolio_v2.name: Space Portfolio V2
space_portfolio_v2.description: An immersive portfolio presented as a spatial universe, combining a real-time 3D scene, planet-based navigation, a custom design system, and bilingual professional content.
highlights: Navigable 3D universe with planets, orbital camera, and custom shaders
Accessible fallback for devices without WebGL and performance presets
Unit and E2E tests, bundle budget, and PT/EN internationalization

mta_analytics.name: MTA Analytics
mta_analytics.description: A full-stack telemetry platform for MTA servers that collects player, economy, and combat events and turns them into real-time operational insights.
highlights: Lua telemetry collector integrated with a REST API and WebSocket
Asynchronous event processing with BullMQ and Redis
Multi-server dashboard with economic analytics and 3D heatmaps

ping_on_place.name: PingOnPlace
ping_on_place.description: A mobile contextual reminder app that monitors geographic regions in the background and notifies users when they enter or leave a configured location.
highlights: Native background geofencing for location-based reminders
Local notifications, haptic feedback, and interactive maps
Offline operation with local persistence and no backend dependency

code_collab.name: Code Collab
code_collab.description: A collaborative coding environment with a professional browser editor, instant synchronization between participants, and persistent projects and rooms.
